content: Search UX: debounce the API-triggering state (not the visible text field) at 300-600ms after typing stops; never block the input itself. Show a lightweight in-progress affordance during debounce/fetch. Empty query = show the default vitrine list (do not blank the screen). Zero-results state must name the search term, avoid feeling like an error, and give a one-tap recovery action (e.g. clear search / show all).
